== Notes ==
* Combines well with [[Deny Hexes]].
* Combined with the Elementalist Elite, [[Glyph of Renewal]], this enchantment can be kept up permanently as an effective form of energy management.

;[[Hero AI]]
* Heroes do not use this very effectively, often casting it at inappropriate times (at the end of a battle or outside of a battle completely) and not bothering to use it when it's recharged and running low on energy.
